content:
maria_g: Quick playtest — updated battlecard claims vs managed cloud AI + LLM APIs. Need fast feedback on what to put in launch post/webinar hooks. Priority: latency/cost, private deploy, rollout tools. Thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devin: love it. Can we add a concrete example showing 2x lower median latency at 512 tokens vs VendorX? numbers sell.

sasha: short soundbite idea: "Ship LLM features without inflating your infra bill." then a 1-liner for privacy: "VPC & on-prem options for regulated apps." :shield:

raj_p: Do we have the benchmark spreadsheet link? need QPS and cost per 1M tokens by model family. product will ask.

maria_g: here's a quick snapshot (not full spreadsheet): <https://notion.redwood/battlebench-quick> 

``
Model: open-65B | latency@512: 120ms | cost/1M tok: $24
VendorX-70B | latency@512: 260ms | cost/1M tok: $47
``

tomk: can we avoid naming VendorX directly in the launch post? legal flagged direct calls out. Maybe use "leading managed cloud APIs" phrasing.

jen_m: we can keep a private slide with explicit comparisons, public copy uses "leading managed providers" + callout CTA to benchmark page.

sasha: webinar hook: quick demo — show "failover to cheaper variant" + routing rule live, emphasize "graceful degradation" rather than "we're faster".

devin: also include a tiny config snippet in the battlecard for platform teams:

```
routing:
  - priority: latency
  - fallback: quantized-variant
```

raj_p: need one-liner for SDRs about pricing: "predictable reserved capacity vs unpredictable per-token bills." simple.

maria_g: agree. I'll make 3 public soundbites (latency, predictability, private deploy) + 2 hidden bench slides + 1 operational snippet. I'll patch Notion and DM you the draft. @notion-bot publish when ready.

notion-bot: Page "Marketing/Battlecards/Claim Playtest" scheduled publish in 30m.

tomk: looks good — can we run a micro A/B on messaging in the newsletter? 3 variants: pragmatic econ, reliability-first, and ops-first. quick tests next week.

maria_g: perf. I'll push drafts by EOD. Thanks all :rocket:
